title: Sobhagyasusthi Pak
description: Sobhagyasusthi Pak (Saubhagya Sunthi Pak) is a highly revered classical post-natal restorative jam where dried ginger (Sunthi) is the primary therapeutic agent, cooked with milk, ghee, and protective herbs. This classical formulation is specially designed for mothers post-delivery. Improves digestion after pregnancy. Cleanses the uterus promoting healing. Reduces body aches from delivery strain. Safely increases breast milk production.
dosage: 10–15 grams in the morning and evening with a glass of warm milk
